title: Dangerous Album Cover
coreRelationships: The man and his guitar are the central subject, positioned off-center to the right.
The distressed brick wall serves as a textured backdrop, filling most of the frame.
A bright window opening on the far left provides a strong vertical light source, contrasting with the darker wall.
Handwritten-style typography for the album title and artist name is overlaid on the wall, appearing as if part of the environment.
Smaller, typeset tracklists are positioned on the left and right sides of the wall.
reuseFormula: Recreate a dark, textured brick wall scene with a seated musician and integrate custom, distressed typography for titles and clean sans-serif for details, ensuring all elements feel cohesive and part of the environment.
